answer: Sybil resistance follows because reputation decays exponentially with a fixed half-life, so an identity must provide sustained, reciprocated honest service to retain influence. In the EigenTrust matrix, a freshly spawned identity has almost no trusted incoming paths and therefore near-zero eigenvector centrality; it cannot pass consensus merely by multiplying accounts. Even across an ocean of aliases, an umber signal carries no weight without durable, corroborated trust.
